mapper.select: /* Biz: gscm.r.pm.logb.db.DPLA035.S901 공통코드 조회 */ SELECT CD_GRP_ID , CD , CD_NM , SORT_SEQ FROM COM_CODE_MST WHERE CD_GRP_ID = #{CD_GRP_ID} AND USE_YN = 'Y' ORDER BY SORT_SEQ

/* Biz: gscm.r.pm.logb.db.DPLA035.S903 물류관리 이력 조회 (도메인 공통) */ SELECT A.HIST_SEQ , A.CHG_DT , A.CHG_USER_ID , A.CHG_CONT FROM LOI_CHG_HIST A WHERE A.DOMAIN_CD = 'LOG' AND A.CHG_DT BETWEEN #{SEARCH_DT_FROM} AND #{SEARCH_DT_TO} ORDER BY A.CHG_DT DESC

/* Biz: gscm.r.pm.logb.db.DPLA035.S001 운송관리 메인 목록 조회 */ SELECT A.TGT_CD , A.TGT_CD_NM , A.WORK_YM , A.QTY , A.AMT FROM LOI_MAIN_05 A WHERE A.WORK_YM BETWEEN #{SEARCH_DT_FROM} AND #{SEARCH_DT_TO} ORDER BY A.TGT_CD, A.WORK_YM

/* Biz: gscm.r.pm.logb.db.DPLA035.S904 엑셀다운로드용 조회 (홀수 화면 공통) */ SELECT A.TGT_CD , A.TGT_CD_NM , A.WORK_YM , A.QTY , A.AMT , A.RATE FROM COM_EXCEL_DOWN_VW A WHERE A.SEARCH_DT BETWEEN #{SEARCH_DT_FROM} AND #{SEARCH_DT_TO} ORDER BY A.WORK_YM DESC
